records.question: James runs a TV show and there are 5 main characters and 4 minor characters.  He pays the minor characters $15,000 each episode.  He paid the major characters three times as much.  How much does he pay per episode?
records.response:
James pays the 5 main characters 5*3*15000 = 225000 per episode.
James pays the 4 minor characters 4*15000 = 60000 per episode.
All together, James pays 225000+60000 = 285000 per episode.
#### 285000

records.question: Sidney has 4 kittens and 3 adult cats.  She has 7 cans of cat food.  Each adult cat eats 1 can of food per day.  Each kitten eats 3/4 of a can per day.  How many additional cans of food does Sidney need to buy to feed all of her animals for 7 days.
records.response:
Each adult cat eats 1 can of food per day.  So the 3 adult cats will eat 3 cans of food per day.  Each kitten eats 3/4 of a can per day.  So the 4 kittens will eat 4 * 3/4 = 3 cans of food per day.  In total, Sidney needs to feed 3 + 3 = 6 cans of food per day.  In 7 days, Sidney needs to feed 6 * 7 = 42 cans of food.  Sidney has 7 cans of food.  Therefore, Sidney needs to buy 42 - 7 = 35 more cans of food.
#### 35
